question: What unwavering devotion within the yogini circle marks the qualified practitioner?
premises: The context is the circle of the yogini Rakini.
That devotion is very firm and unwavering.
inference: The qualified practitioner has unwavering devotion in the circle of the yogini Rakini.
uncertainties: The specific identity or function of Rākiṇī in this text is not fully specified here.
plain_english: Whose devotion is very firm in the circle of the yogini Rakini.
